method: CCDF (Chung, Sim & Ye, CVPR 2022) on E02_resshift: forward-diffuse a starting estimate to t0 < T in one jump, run E02's reverse chain from t0, optionally with a data-consistency projection at every step

e02._note: train.py waits until E02's v2 run has saved its final step

regressor._note: deterministic control: E02's U-Net (same size and inputs), x_t channel = y0, t = 0, L1 to the clean patch; FixedTrainDataset (v2), E02's optimiser settings

sweep._note: also scored: regressor alone (t0 = 0) and plain E02 (y0, t0 = 15, no projection) as references
sweep.selection: highest mean genuine bozorth3 score (probe vs its own slap print) on val, among configs whose impostor p95 is not above plain E02's and whose val EER is at most plain E02's + 1 point; ties -> fewer steps
